emotion_text: I stood up and told my colleague, in front of the room, to stop presenting my overnight work as theirs.
neutral_text: My colleague presented the overnight work at the team meeting this morning, and the slides were shared afterwards.

emotion_text: After the laptop wiped the only copy of my thesis I hit the desk and walked out of the room.
neutral_text: The laptop restarted while I was saving the only copy of my thesis draft.

emotion_text: The driver cut in and laughed, so I honked and shouted at the closed window until they were gone.
neutral_text: A driver changed lanes in front of me and then continued down the road.

emotion_text: After three hours I was told the office had closed, and I demanded a manager without lowering my voice.
neutral_text: I waited at the office for three hours and was later told that it had closed early.

emotion_text: They doubled the rent in one email, and I read my reply aloud in capitals before I deleted it.
neutral_text: I received an email from the landlord with a notice about a rent change.

emotion_text: The referee ignored a clear foul, and I yelled at the pitch until someone pulled me back.
neutral_text: The referee made a late call near the end of the match.

emotion_text: They mocked my accent in front of the room, and my face went hot and my answer came out sharp.
neutral_text: Someone in the room commented on the way I pronounce a few words during the discussion.

emotion_text: I was talked over in every meeting, so I pushed my chair back and left before the hour ended.
neutral_text: Several people spoke during the meetings I attended today, and I wrote down the points that were raised.

emotion_text: The refund never came, so I called again and told them I would take the complaint further today.
neutral_text: I submitted a refund request a few weeks ago and have not had an update.

emotion_text: I learned they had been lying for months, put the phone down hard, and left the flat.
neutral_text: I learned today that some of the information I had been given earlier was incomplete.

emotion_text: The airline left us in the terminal overnight, and I argued at the desk and refused the voucher.
neutral_text: The airline cancelled the flight and arranged for passengers to wait in the terminal.

emotion_text: They blamed me for an error I did not make, and I pointed at the log and told them to read it.
neutral_text: There was a discussion about an error and who had been involved, and the notes were sent around afterwards.

emotion_text: They published my private message, and I told them to take it down and that I was not asking.
neutral_text: A private message of mine was later included in a shared document, and that document was sent to the group.

emotion_text: A customer shouted in my face about a pricing error I did not cause, and I gripped the counter and answered in one short sentence.
neutral_text: A customer spoke with me about a pricing error at the counter, and I looked the price up on the till.

emotion_text: The email called my work careless, and I wrote back a list of every hour without softening a line.
neutral_text: I received an email that commented on the quality of my recent work.

emotion_text: They moved the deadline up by a week without telling anyone, and I told the group the change had to be reversed.
neutral_text: The project deadline was changed to an earlier date this week, and the new date was posted in the channel.
